verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents an AI Assistant that takes plain-language requests and acts on them: it reads threads, writes drafts, searches email history and checks the calendar. Users can also write custom filters as plain-English scripts, and the scheduler accepts natural-language send times. Together these cover the core of natural-language operation. However, the evidence does not show that the full set of inbox operations can be driven through natural-language commands, and none of it comes from independent hands-on testing. missing for 10: documented natural-language control over general app operations (archiving, labeling, navigation and settings via chat commands), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language command use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
